notes.title: Client-Server Update Released!
notes.content:
A new patch is now available on Steam. With this update, both the client and server can handle multiple stacks of items.

Previously, the game could only recognize one stack of any particular item. This limitation is now resolved. Players no longer have to consolidate their items into a single stack - the client and server will efficiently manage multiple stacks!

notes.title: Christmas Event
notes.content:
🎄Happy Christmas! 🎄

I hope you're all ready for a festive season filled with joy and cheer. I'm thrilled to announce that Anime Collector Evo's Christmas event kicks off December 25, 2023, at 4 PM AEDT! 🎅🌟

Special Access Offer: Haven't joined the Anime Collector Evo world yet? For tomorrow only, ping @Developers or @Squids Around in ⁠our discord server , and I'll personally ensure you get a key to the universe. Please be patient; I'll work my magic to get your key as soon as possible! 🗝️✨

Attention Newcomers: As our valued testers, your feedback is vital in enhancing our new database system. Keep in mind that as we evolve, some features might be in flux, but your insights help me create a better experience for everyone. 🛠️🔄

🔔 Exciting Patch Notes: 🔔

+[NEW ZONE] SkyVillage: A festive wonderland awaits in the Xmas Event Zone!
+[NEW ENEMY] Snow Monster: Brace yourself for frosty foes!
+[NEW ORE] Crimson Ice: Discover and gather this chilly resource!
+[NEW CURRENCY] Christmas Coin: Collect and spend these special festive tokens!
+[UPGRADE] Resource Gathering System: Say goodbye to tedious 'E' pressing – now just aim and shoot to gather!

While i've made significant progress, some anticipated features need more polish and will be introduced in the next update, including:

- Fair Loot Distribution: No more loot snatching in non-PVP zones!
- Enhanced Audio Experience: Get ready for auditory delight!
- Thrilling PVP Arena: Test your skills against other players!
- Evo Cities Market Area: A new hub for trading and interacting with NPCs!

Thank you all for being part of this journey with me. Your support and enthusiasm are what drive the continuous growth and improvement of Anime Collector Evo. Let's dive into this festive adventure together! ❤️🎮

notes.title: Awakening Update
notes.content:
So for the first time i am using steam to release my patch notes, It's recently been brought to my attention that some users who have access to the game do not use Discord so from now on i will be releasing the patch notes via steam.

Patch Notes:

(UPDATED) Starting Island

(ADDED) ALL PATREON REWARDS. (Angel Wings, Demon Wings, Angel Halo, Demon Halo)



(COMING SOON) Futa Art. Sadly i was unable to complete the art set in this update. It will be added once completed


In this update i am aiming to test how many different kinds of enemies the server can handle in a single channel. Because of this server stability may not be great during the initial testing of this update.

If you would like to support the development of "Anime Collector: EVO" please consider checking out our PATREON page. As of this update we will be updating all reward tiers.

As of this update i will also be updating the Steam Store Page and all related details to the game.

Server will come ONLINE in 15 minutes
